arguments.value: Kiromic, Inc. entered into a consulting agreement with Gianluca Rotino effective July 1, 2018. The agreement continues until either side ends it by written notice; the source does not state a fixed end date. Rotino is an independent contractor who will provide agreed consulting services such as business analysis, business development support, marketing and communications support, and help with clinical product pipeline priorities. He will be paid $400 per hour, with a cap of 19 hours per month unless management preapproves more, subject to required withholdings and any company compensation policy changes on prior written notice. He must keep company confidential information private, not use it for other purposes, and return company property and confidential materials when the agreement ends or sooner if requested. Any inventions or work created in connection with the services belong to the company, and Rotino must help the company secure intellectual property rights. He may not subcontract or assign the agreement without consent, must avoid conflicts of interest, and must comply with no-debarment and other representations. The agreement is governed by Texas law, and disputes must be resolved by binding arbitration in Houston, Texas.
